During the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]]'s [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the galaxy<ref name="EA" /> between [[25 ABY/Legends|25]] and [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', pp. XIII</ref> the [[Species/Legends|species]] '''attacked''' the [[Ord Janon system/Legends|Ord Janon system]]. Taking place at a point between 25 ABY and [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], the assault was preceded by the [[Battle of Birgis]],<ref name="EA" /> in which the Yuuzhan Vong captured the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Birgis]] from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] with the aid of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]].<ref name="BF:APM">''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]''</ref> After Birgis the Yuuzhan Vong split their forces to strike two targets, one of which traveled to the Ord Janon system.<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The attack on the Ord Janon system was first shown in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a sourcebook released in [[2009]] and written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]]. The Atlas included the attack in a map titled "Vector Prime and the Yuuzhan Vong advance" which showed the movements and conflicts of the various factions involved in the Yuuzhan Vong War, between 25 ABY and 26 ABY. The book gives no information on the outcome of the attack, but a separate map shows the Ord Janon system was under Yuuzhan Vong control by 26 ABY.<ref name="EA" />
